description: Estaciones de servicio is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria de Innovación y Transformación Digital. Información y ubicación geográfica de las estaciones de servicio de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaria de Innovación y Transformación Digital. Its tags are combustible, estaciones de servicio, mapa. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
